Manifest.Description: 1.31 applies the full reviewed Korean proofreading merge on top of 1.30: 279 keys updated, including italic-action spacing, speech-level and punctuation fixes, and unified 영양 열매 terminology. Outdated, misaligned and structurally incompatible entries remain excluded, and current keys are retained. The 1.30 harem v2 perfume coverage, 1.29 Lydia closure-date/reward/barter fixes, 1.28 Security channel and maid localization, 1.27 Serpico delay and earlier fixes remain. Story routes, outcomes, target days and endings are unchanged. 1.31 在 1.30 基础上应用完整的韩语校对合并：更新 279 个 key，包括斜体动作后的空格、语气与标点修正，并统一使用“영양 열매”术语；过期、错位和结构不兼容的条目继续排除，当前 key 全部保留。保留 1.30 后宫 v2 香水覆盖、1.29 莉迪亚闭店约会/奖励/警告礼修复、1.28 治安部渠道与侍从线本地化、1.27 Serpico 顺延及更早修复。不改路线、选项结果、目标日或结局。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
